attributes.name: form_field_arrangement
attributes.definition: How the email input and submit button are laid out relative to each other in the newsletter signup.

values.definition: Input and button sit side by side in one horizontal row, joined or adjacent.
Input and button are stacked vertically.
Arrangement is not stated or no signup present.

attributes.name: signup_section_container
attributes.definition: How the newsletter signup is contained on the page.

values.definition: A dedicated full-width section or colored band spanning the page.
A small block within the footer or another section, not a dedicated band.

attributes.name: submit_button_color
attributes.definition: Color treatment of the newsletter submit button.

values.definition: Button uses a filled brand/accent color (including green).
Button is neutral/default colored or outlined.
